label: PF Backlog 620
title: test_backlog_dod depends on the gitignored dev-api-token file -> red in any clean checkout/CI
body: RCCA: (1) test_backlog_dod._op() read data/local/dev-api-token directly. (2) That path is gitignored (.gitignore:45 product-forge/data/local/) so the file is absent in CI/fresh worktrees. (3) The test then errored FileNotFoundError, failing the 3 DoD tests in every clean checkout. Why it slipped: the test was authored/run on a machine that had already run the dev server (which creates the token). Guard: the test now computes the token via api.auth._token() (no file dependency) - the same mechanism the app uses.

objective: Make the DoD tests hermetic so they pass in a clean checkout (no untracked local token file).
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline test suite is green in a clean checkout with NO data/local/dev-api-token present (that token is gitignored under product-forge/data/local/ and must never be required by a test).

test_backlog_dod exercises the DoD write-time gate by sending the same token the app computes (api.auth._token), so it passes on CI and in every fresh worktree, not only on a machine that has run the server.
approach: Replace the direct file read in _op() with api.auth._token() (env PF_API_TOKEN/API_TOKEN, else the dev token) so the test needs no local file.
verification: test_backlog_dod + test_dev_auth = 8 passed in a worktree without data/local/dev-api-token
